operations.name: signIn
operations.label: Sign in to Jira
operations.description: Checks a pasted scoped Atlassian API token with the email and site it belongs to, and signs in to Jira with it.

email.description: The email of the Atlassian account the token belongs to.

site.description: The Atlassian site, such as your-team.atlassian.net.

operations.name: addSite
operations.label: Add a Jira site
operations.description: Finds an Atlassian site by its address and uses it for the Project.

site.description: The Atlassian site, such as your-team.atlassian.net.

operations.name: chooseSite
operations.label: Choose a Project's Jira site
operations.description: Choose which Atlassian site a Project's Jira issues come from.

operations.name: chooseProject
operations.label: Choose a Project's Jira project
operations.description: Choose which Jira project a Project shows the issues of.

cloudId.description: The cloud id of the Atlassian site the Jira project is on.

key.description: The Jira project's key, such as ARGO.

operations.name: forgetProject
operations.label: Choose another Jira project
operations.description: Forget a Project's Jira project, so the page asks which one to show again.

operations.name: checkAgain
operations.label: Read Jira again
operations.description: Make the Jira pages read Jira again.

operations.name: listIssues
operations.label: List Jira issues
operations.description: Lists the issues of the Jira project this Project shows, the most recently updated first, with each one's status, assignee, priority and the statuses it can move to.

text.description: Only issues whose text contains this, as Jira's search matches it.

limit.description: How many issues to answer, 1 to 100; 20 when left out.

operations.name: getIssue
operations.label: Read a Jira issue
operations.description: Reads one Jira issue: its summary, description as Markdown, status, assignee, priority, labels, link, and the statuses Jira allows it to move to now.

issue.description: The issue's key, such as ARGO-12.

operations.name: transition
operations.label: Move a Jira issue to a status
operations.description: Moves a Jira issue to another status, as Jira's workflow allows from its current one. Fails with the statuses it can move to when Jira does not allow that move.

issue.description: The issue's key, such as ARGO-12.

status.description: The status to move it to, by name or id, such as In Progress.

operations.name: setAssignee
operations.label: Assign a Jira issue
operations.description: Assigns a Jira issue to a person, to the signed-in person with me, or to nobody.

issue.description: The issue's key, such as ARGO-12.

assignee.description: The person's Atlassian account id, or me for the signed-in person; leave it out to unassign the issue.

operations.name: setPriority
operations.label: Set a Jira issue's priority
operations.description: Sets a Jira issue's priority to one the Jira site has.

issue.description: The issue's key, such as ARGO-12.

priority.description: The priority, by name or id, such as High.

capabilities.reason: Reads and changes Jira issues as the signed-in person.
Finds your Atlassian site's cloud id at <site>.atlassian.net, and tells an unscoped API token from a wrong one. The Plugin calls only *.atlassian.net hosts this way.
